items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR
Award Contract No. WW-784 to J. Flores Construction Company, Inc to replace sections of existing sewer pipe throughout the City and County of San Francisco
items.text: Award Contract No. WW-784, As-Needed Spot Sewer Replacement No. 48, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, J. Flores Construction Company, Inc., in the amount of $10,245,408 and with a duration of 400 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and one month), to replace sections of existing sewer pipe on an as-needed basis at locations that staff will determine throughout the City and County of San Francisco

items.title: Accept work performed by Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc., under Contract No. WW-751 to adjust the final contract amount and authorize final payment to the contractor
items.text: Accept work performed by Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc., under Contract No. WW-751, As-Needed Sewer Inspection (FY24); approve Modification No. 2 (Final) decreasing the contract amount by $1,078,249, with no change to the contract duration, for a total contract amount of $1,893,751, and a total contract duration of 500 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and five months), to adjust the final contract amount to the value of actual contract quantities completed; and authorize final payment to the contractor

items.title: Award Contract No. WD-2920, Water Main and Sewer Replacement on Moraga, Noriega, and Ortega Streets from 8th to 11th Avenue and Various Side Streets to Cratus Inc
items.text: Award Contract No. WD-2920, Water Main and Sewer Replacement on Moraga, Noriega, and Ortega Streets from 8th to 11th Avenue and Various Side Streets, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Cratus Inc., in the amount of $14,490,752 and with a duration of 775 consecutive calendar days (approximately two years and two months), to rehabilitate water pipelines that are over 100 years old in the Sunset District of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on the determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Public Hearing to consider whether to proceed with the proposed adoption of FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28 water rates and to consider and adopt a new schedule of rates for retail water service
items.text: Public Hearing (1) to consider whether to proceed with the proposed adoption of FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28 water rates in light of written objections and the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission’s responses; and (2) to consider and adopt a new schedule of rates for retail water service in San Francisco and suburban areas, to be effective with meter readings on or after July 1, 2026. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Public Hearing to consider whether to proceed with the proposed adoption of the FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28 sewer rates and to consider and adopt a new annual schedule of rates for sewer service in San Francisco
items.text: Public Hearing: (1) to consider whether to proceed with the proposed adoption of the FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28 sewer rates in light of Written Objections and the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission’s responses; and (2) to consider and adopt a new annual schedule of rates for sewer service in San Francisco, to be effective with meter readings on or after July 1, 2026. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Public Hearing to consider the adoption of rates of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Power Enterprise for Hetch Hetchy Power service
items.text: Public Hearing to consider the adoption of rates of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Power Enterprise for Hetch Hetchy Power service, to be effective with meter readings beginning on or after July 1, 2026. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Proposed Wholesale Water Rates for Fiscal Year 2026-27, which will become effective for meter readings on or after July 1, 2026
items.text: Consider and adopt the proposed Wholesale Water Rates for Fiscal Year 2026-27, which will become effective for meter readings on or after July 1, 2026. The San Francisco Public Utilities Commission developed the proposed rates in accordance with the terms of the Water Supply Agreement between the City and County of San Francsico and its Wholesale Customers, which the Commission approved on April 28, 2009, by Resolution No. 09-0069, and most recently amended and restated on May 14, 2025, by Resolution No. 25-0074, with subsequent approval by the Wholesale Customers. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that this action is exempt from the CEQA. If the item is approved, the Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision

items.title: Contract No. WD-2893, Sunol Valley Chloramination Facility Improvements, with Anvil Builders, Inc to address design changes for control systems and cost and schedule impacts
items.text: Approve an increase of $2,000,000 to the cost contingency and 700 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WD-2893, Sunol Valley Chloramination Facility Improvements, with Anvil Builders, Inc., for a revised cost limit of $12,283,350 and a revised duration limit of 1,426 consecutive calendar days (approximately 3 years and 10 months), to address design changes for control systems, and cost and schedule impacts due to changes by the SFPUC to the planned facility shutdown schedule to accommodate operational needs during the 2025-26 Hetch Hetchy System shutdown

items.title: Contract No. WW-723R, Channel Force Main Intertie, with Anvil Builders Inc requiring additional pipe modifications and to extend dry weather restricted work into 2026
items.text: Approve an increase of $2,800,000 to the existing cost contingency and 243 calendar days to the existing duration contingency for Contract No. WW-723R, Channel Force Main Intertie, with Anvil Builders Inc., for a revised cost limit of $22,175,899 and a revised duration limit of 1,374 consecutive calendar days, due to unforeseen existing pipe conditions requiring additional pipe modifications and to extend dry weather restricted work into 2026 to support ongoing construction activities
